card.name: Just before the word prostaglandin
card.fires_on: The word just before "prostaglandin" in NSAID label text, such as "renal" or "of" after "inhibition". Also the start of the word prostaglandin itself ("prost").

modes.label: Word before prostaglandin
modes.description: A linking or describing word right before "prostaglandin synthesis", such as "renal" after "inhibition of".
